Done — I gave the UI a fresher, more modern feel and split the frontend into smaller files without changing the app’s behavior.

What I changed:
- Refreshed the styling with:
  - softer gradients/backgrounds
  - glassy navbar/cards
  - improved spacing, shadows, and button states
  - cleaner auth and dashboard presentation
- Split frontend JS into smaller files:
  - `public/js/utils/dom.js`
  - `public/js/utils/tasks.js`
  - kept `api.js`, `auth.js`, and `app.js` focused
- Broke CSS into modular files:
  - `public/css/base.css`
  - `public/css/layout.css`
  - `public/css/components.css`
  - `public/css/pages.css`
  - `public/css/style.css` now just imports them
- Tidied HTML pages to use the new styling structure and scripts
- Simplified `src/app.js` a bit by removing some extra comments/verbosity

Note:
- I tried to run the tests, but the container is missing `supertest`, so the test suite couldn’t execute here.
